exact_blockers.detail: No exact runnable ASR/translation source, runtime, or pinned artifact with immutable revision, bytes, SHA-256, and reviewed rights is staged.
exact_blockers.reopen: Provide an exactly pinned runnable ASR/translation runtime or separately licensed artifact with immutable revision, bytes, SHA-256, and a reviewed rights record.
exact_blockers.title: exact_asr_translation_runtime_absent

exact_blockers.detail: No typed transcript, segmentation clock, unknown-language behavior, or versioned normalization contract is pinned for deterministic SDK-facing adapter output.
exact_blockers.reopen: Pin typed transcript/segment/language/normalization schemas and deterministic fail-closed validation on the exact runtime.
exact_blockers.title: typed_transcript_segmentation_language_contract_unpinned

exact_blockers.detail: No rights-cleared matched cohort, transcript/translation references, controls, or pinned scorers are staged for recognition, translation, or timing quality.
exact_blockers.reopen: Freeze a rights-cleared cohort with references, controls, and pinned scoring for recognition, translation, segmentation, and unknown-language behavior.
exact_blockers.title: matched_cohort_controls_and_scorers_absent

exact_blockers.detail: No target-device timing, rights/output-use review, opt-in intake, independent review, or release approval exists.

gates.reopen_condition: Stage a reviewed, exactly pinned runtime/artifact with immutable revision, byte count, SHA-256, and rights record.
gates.statement: An exact runnable ASR/translation runtime or artifact revision, immutable bytes, SHA-256, and reviewed rights/output-use terms must be pinned.
gates.title: exact_runtime_artifact_and_rights_identity

gates.reopen_condition: Pin schemas and pass deterministic validation/adverse cases on the exact runtime without guessing missing fields.
gates.statement: Typed transcript, segment timing, confidence, unknown-language, and versioned normalization contracts must be deterministic and fail closed.
gates.title: typed_transcript_and_normalization_contract

gates.reopen_condition: Provide exact clock mapping, partial/final/end-of-stream semantics, and deterministic timestamp tests on the target runtime.
gates.statement: Segmentation clock, partial/final endpoint semantics, and source timestamp mapping must be exact and independently verifiable.
gates.title: segmentation_clock_and_endpoint_semantics

gates.reopen_condition: Freeze language/translation scope and prove fail-closed unknown/unsupported behavior with reviewed references.
gates.statement: Unknown language, unsupported language, and translation scope must be explicit typed outcomes, never silent fallback or fabricated text.
gates.title: unknown_language_and_translation_scope

gates.reopen_condition: Freeze cohort/splits/references/scorers and produce matched evidence on the exact runtime.
gates.statement: A rights-cleared matched cohort with references, controls, and pinned scorers is required for recognition, translation, and timing quality.
gates.title: frozen_cohort_controls_and_scorers

gates.reopen_condition: Pass deterministic adverse coverage with no state mutation or qualifying output on rejection.
gates.statement: Missing, invalid, malformed, nonfinite, out-of-range, and rights-missing inputs must fail closed with no partial qualifying result.
gates.title: adverse_invalid_nonfinite_and_missing_input_handling

gates.reopen_condition: Measure paced availability/latency/resource behavior on target hardware with explicit deadline accounting.
gates.statement: Paced target-runtime availability, latency, memory, and endpoint timing must be measured on the exact runtime and device class.
gates.title: paced_timing_and_target_runtime

gates.reopen_condition: Pass a separate versioned intake and independent review with no default registration and no release claim.
gates.statement: An opt-in, default-OFF provider/tool intake, independent exact-head review, and release approval are required before exposure.
gates.title: opt_in_intake_review_and_release
